win.title: AAACHOO!
win.body: Just enough histamine. The mast cell tipped past threshold, calcium poured in, granules emptied into the tissue — and the body fired off a sneeze to expel the invader.
win.biologyLine: That's an allergic reaction. Mast cells coated in IgE dump histamine when allergens crosslink them. The sneeze is your body throwing them back out.

fail.title: ANAPHYLAXIS
fail.body: Too much. Mast cells flooded the tissue with histamine, blood vessels dilated, airways swelled, blood pressure crashed.
fail.biologyLine: Severe allergic reaction — life-threatening within minutes. This is why people with serious allergies carry adrenaline auto-injectors.

hints.drag: Drag the pollen up — all the way up the nose
hints.hold: Swirl around the pollen to release more
hints.pinch: Spread two fingers (or press +) to release more
